title: Elha Nympha withdraws from ‘Inday: The Musical,' cites ‘breach of contract’
summary: Elha Nympha confirmed her withdrawal from headlining “Inday: The Musical,” saying her decision was prompted by the alleged “material breaches of contract by the organizers.”…

blocks.text: Elha Nympha confirmed her withdrawal from headlining “Inday: The Musical,” saying her decision was prompted by the alleged “material breaches of contract by the organizers.” Production company Studio A Productions earlier announced that Nympha had stepped away from the show, a day before its scheduled opening on Oct. 16. “Studio A Productions respects the decision of Ms. Elha Nympha to step away from ‘Inday: The Musical,’ a day before its scheduled opening,” it said. “Our creative team is now making the necessary adjustments to bring Inday to life, and we are fully committed to opening the show on the scheduled dates.” […]...
